author: BellaEaglesDiva
quote:
I actually bought the 100$. I am playing it now and so far I'm almost done with chapter 2, seemingly. There is good and bad but it is no masterpiece. 

The good: there is a lot to do. The map is massive. Easter eggs. Some of the radio stations are great. Lots of wildlife and things to collect if you're into that kinda of dynamic in games. It also has some funny parts. I love the way the guns sound too. Doesn't sound weak at all. 

The bad. It starts off as a dating simulator. The game is Lucia centered. Her character is extremely annoying. Her missions are long, boring and annoying. Jason is an errand boy. I despise the Bonnie and Clyde direction they went with this. As of now, the mechanic shop is trash, the evading the cops system is trash, too much realism. The whole point of us gamers wanting to game is to escape our realities only for Rockstar to throw us right back in them. The empathy system **** bad. You can kill some NPCs while certain "colorful" NPCs are protected.... This game is a copy and paste of RDR2  in so many ways, only moved into modern day. We waited 13 years+ to get a watered down, feminized, DEI version of what GTA used to be. GTA5 is hands down way better. Better characters, better storyline, better everything almost. So I'm going to finish it, I don't want my money wasted. Idk about GTA online either because they charge 8$ a month. Just seems like a huge money grab for something so watered down and lackluster. This is definitely not what I and so many others expected, nor what we wanted. While I love both GTA and RDR2, they should be completely separate and different games. They should be polar opposites. I wanted to Scarface my way through Vice City and instead we got a chore list and a **** girlfriend. Who thought this was a great idea. Props to the marketing department of Rockstar cause they created the hype, paid for the excellent reviews and shafted so many gamers. I am a gamer girl and I don't even like the relationship drama of this game. It's ridiculous. Had I known, I'd have definitely waited or skipped all together. 

Lastly, it is extremely glitchy but I suspect like CD Project red did with Cyberpunk 2077, they'll do many updates and fix this. Unfortunately an update can't fix the storyline. I am happy for those that do like it, but it has fallen flat for me thus far.
